name: Chang'e-5 Shangsheng Qi
about: Chang'e-5 Shangsheng Qi (2020-087, LDSE/CAST), launched 2020 Nov 23. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
